verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, plus Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) support. An agent could use these to create splits and send commands, but only on macOS. libghostty is a developer library for building terminals, not a control API for the running app, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: evidence of reading terminal output programmatically, a cross-platform (Linux) control protocol or API, in-depth reference docs for the scripting interface, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
